independent_cpu.population_note: Each child has one observed workload PID/TID and one CPU in mask; actual population, not worker-permit inference.
independent_cpu.supersedes: fp-wave-v1-independent-cpu-summary-v1.json (over-escaped parser reported zero; no raw capture changed).

interpretation_limits: Qualified rows require inline stage_timed_commit lines 382-402 inside inline timed_iteration lines 404-449, exact paired non-inline physical timed_iteration ancestry, and source checks. This is conservative ancestry, not timed phase measurement.

Whole-process cycles:u includes startup/loader, corpus/preflight/setup, timed route, verification, and teardown. Periods are sampled event weights, not elapsed time or exact cycle totals. FP/debug2 generated code differs from native baseline; no latency/speedup comparison follows.

Source-owner ranking is withheld. Strict source grouping accepts absolute deepest source file:line only; unresolved rows remain denominator. Physical full-symbol+DSO groups are additive exclusive sampled self including inline callees and excluding out-of-line descendants.
Inclusive tags/heuristic owner categories overlap and are not additive; generic next is not a source owner without full source key and ancestry.
Header BUILD_ID missing-features note is retained; MMAP2 mapping/buildid-list exports bind every target to analyzer ELF ID/SHA-256.
Inline export rc0 initially had process_group_clear=false; late-clearance receipt and exact sealed stream are bound. Physical export/analyzer terminal receipts cleared before parse.
purpose: Independent read-only admission of completed six-child FP/debug2 CPU attribution wave.

schedule.thread_scope: inherit enabled; all threads retained in denominator; qualified ancestry thread-local.

scope: Diagnostic sampled CPU ancestry only: custody, binary/thread/sample identity, exact paired decoding, and additive conservation. No elapsed phase, whole-process CPU fraction, speedup, allocation/RSS, production, CI, or baseline-comparison claim.
